8.long_description:
Pump It Up XX Upgrade Kits and Gameboard Kits are now available for order, with the first batch shipping soon. The exciting new game from Andamiro celebrates the 20th Anniversary of the Pump It Up series, and is bigger and better than before. With an extensive music library with free updates every 2 months, linking with PIUM and PIU H5, an online matching system for players and enhanced user interface, the latest Pump It Up instalment is sure to amaze.

Upgrade Kits
The Upgrade Kits include the following:

  • Pump it Up XX 20th Anniversary HDD and security dongle
  • BONUS 50 pcs AM Pump it Up XX 20th Anniversary Player Cards
  • Pump it Up XX 20th Anniversary Machine Header (CX, TX, LX cabinets only)


Please note, customers must have the MK9 motherboard in order to use the upgrade kit

Gameboard Kits

The Gameboard Kits include the following:

  •  Pump it Up XX 20th Anniversary MK9 motherboard with HDD and security dongle
  • BONUS 50 pcs AM Pump it Up XX 20th Anniversary Player Cards
  • Pump it Up XX 20th Anniversary Machine Header (CX, TX, LX cabinets only)
